meta_description:
1,252 likes, 36 comments - hercircleofficial on October 16, 2026: "Dia Mirza has spent years championing sustainability, bringing environmental advocacy into the mainstream and making conscious living part of the conversation. The roots of that commitment go back to her childhood in Hyderabad, where nature was part of her education, solar energy was being explored at home, and repairing things was a point of pride.

In conversation with Tanya Chaitanya for 𝘏𝘦𝘳 𝘊𝘪𝘳𝘤𝘭𝘦 𝘖𝘳𝘪𝘨𝘪𝘯𝘢𝘭𝘴, Dia looks back at the experiences that shaped her environmental consciousness and shares how those values inform her life today, from mindful purchases for her son to the way she travels. It’s a perspective on sustainability shaped by years of advocacy, personal conviction and the lessons from childhood that continue to stay with us. 

Credits

CEO & Editor-in-Chief: Tanya Chaitanya @tanyachaitanya27

Head - Marketing & Comms: Iona Chatterjee @ionachatterjee

Art Director & Video Editor: Sameer More @sambeingg

Videographer: Harish Iyer @iyerishh

Assistant Videographer: Yash Bedi @yashu.bedi_

On-location Support: Nikita Bajaj @missbajaj_25

#HerCircleOriginals #HerCircle #HerCircleCommunity #DiaMirza #SustainableLife".
